name: Tours & Nature
seo: Kawasan Falls, Osmeña Peak, the canyon at Badian, Sirao's flower farms — Cebu's outdoors is a day trip away from the city, and most of it is booked through small local operators. Here are the tour desks, guides and park entries with a track record, plus the waterfalls, viewpoints and theme parks worth the drive, so you can plan the day rather than buy it from a tricycle driver.

subSeo.Tours: Local operators for day trips: canyoneering, whale sharks, island hopping, city and countryside tours.
subSeo.Waterfalls: Kawasan, Tumalog, Aguinid and the smaller falls — entry fees, guides and how hard the walk in is.
subSeo.Hiking: Osmeña Peak, Mount Naupa and the ridge trails — short climbs with big views, most doable in a morning.
subSeo.Viewpoints: Tops, ridges and sunset spots, from Busay above the city to the cliffs of the south coast.
subSeo.Theme Parks: Water parks, adventure parks and the Cebu Safari — full-day outings for families.

items.name: Nalu Dive
items.address: Kontiki Marina, Pajac-Maribago Rd, Maribago, Lapu-Lapu, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Nalu Dive offers a friendly, highly professional atmosphere that makes even first-time divers feel completely safe and relaxed. Guided by attentive instructors like O'Neil, visitors enjoy easy beach entries to explore vibrant coral reefs, sea turtles, and massive sardine runs. For a seamless trip, take advantage of their prompt pickup service, secure lockers, and delicious Japanese curry lunch between dives.

items.name: RJR Minigolf Moalboal
items.address: Panagsama Rd, Basdiot, Moalboal, 6032 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: RJR Minigolf Moalboal offers a charming, peaceful, and well-maintained 12-hole course filled with fun challenges, including particularly tricky 8th and 12th holes. Visitors consistently praise the exceptionally warm and welcoming owners, Ryza and Rene, who provide great tips, friendly conversation, and a delightful personal touch. Practical tip: Visit in the evening to play under cooler conditions, as the spot stays open until 10 PM and has drinks available on-site.

items.name: Let's Go Trek Tours
items.address: National Hiway, Badian, 6031 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Let's Go Trek Tours offers an exhilarating, high-energy canyoneering adventure in Badian filled with stunning waterfalls, optional jumps, and a thrilling zipline start. Visitors consistently praise the outstanding 1:1 guide-to-guest ratio, highlighting the team's exceptional focus on safety, friendly support for hesitant trekkers, and expert photo capturing. For the best experience, bring your own towels, prepare for a moderate physical workout, and book an early 7:00 AM slot to beat the crowds.

items.name: Nug-as Forest Reserve
items.address: PF72+4PW, Alcoy, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Nug-as Forest Reserve is a serene, eco-friendly sanctuary offering a refreshing cool climate and a peaceful ambiance perfect for escaping urban stress. Nature enthusiasts will love its secluded charm and the chance to spot unique local wildlife like the siloy bird. It is an ideal destination for anyone seeking peace of mind, solitude, and a total stress-relieving reset in nature.
